results_due: mid-January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (13-29 Oct)
reasoning: Q2 revenue jumped 61% on the quarter to ₹1,323 Cr. The order book of ₹2,629 Cr (plus ₹653 Cr of L1 positions) rose even after that billing, and the CFO said the ₹1,900 Cr of inventory exists to execute it in Q3-Q4.
Netweb gives no revenue guidance and its quarters are lumpy (Q2 FY26 ₹304 Cr, Q3 FY26 ₹805 Cr), so we use a wide band around a roughly flat quarter.
Management's EBITDA framework is 13-14%; H1 ran at 15.1% and Q2 at 14.9%, but they said not to quote H1 for the year. We use 14.5%.
risks: Large deals are timed by customers
Gross margin has been falling as component prices rise
NSM 2.0 and Vera Rubin orders only start from early 2027
